items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: once I got to Rutgers University, studying with Ralph Bowen, I learned... he opened my ears and my mind up to a whole world of sound

ctx.x: There’s a certain etiquette to a jazz performance. Can you learn that in jazz school?

It depends on who you’re learning from you know. I mean when you think about people who teach the business of music, if there is a course offered wherever you are and they have a business of music course, sometimes it’s taught by someone who had four gigs before they got that position. You know? And sometimes it’s taught by someone who’s © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

had, you know, a touring career already. So they can share things that the other person didn’t know, or doesn’t know. So really it just depends on who you’re learning from in school. Now if you’re out in the world, because I always say I went to the university of the streets. Because I went to Rutgers University but I learned so much from just playing and being a part of the scene and from people like Bobby Watson and Ralph Peterson, Ralph Bowen and all these, Shirley Scott, Trudy Pitts, just people that I was…

items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: he was actually one of the ones who ended up paying for some of my piano lessons later on and guitar lessons. Like he was very supportive in my career.

ctx.x: The part about, you said your brother used to take you on his bike to your first piano lessons and it got me thinking about piano lessons and how they relate and I wonder, can you recall when you first encountered chord symbols and then what do I do with these?

Without a doubt. You know my mother, jazz was a reward for practicing. Because I just wanted to go straight to jazz. And she was like no, you’re going to do this, you’re going to study classical, blah blah blah. And then you can play jazz. Which was kind of, when I look back on it, it really put the foundation in me for musical theory and different things like that. And then I played a little bit of organ at the church around the corner, at a Lutheran church, so this was a pipe organ when I was still a teenager.…
